WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

UNION ALL SELECT 'stg', count(*), count(distinct return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date) FROM stg_return_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact', count(*), count(distinct return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date) FROM stg_return_line_load WHERE return_line_id NOT IN (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line)

-- skus whose versions differ in subcategory, and how product_key in returns relates to current dim
WITH gf AS (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory='Garden Furniture')
SELECT p.sku, p.product_key, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, p.is_current, p.listed_from, p.delisted_on
FROM dim_product p JOIN gf USING (sku) WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(distinct subcategory)>1 OR count(*)>1) ORDER BY p.sku, p.valid_from

SELECT r.sales_line_id, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) rq, max(s.quantity) sold
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s USING (sales_line_id)
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1 OR sum(r.quantity_returned)>max(s.quantity) OR max(s.quantity) IS NULL

WITH rr AS (
 SELECT r.*, pr.sku r_sku, pr.subcategory r_sub, ps.sku s_sku, ps.subcategory s_sub, ps.category s_cat
 FROM fact_return_line r
 JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key=r.product_key
 JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 JOIN dim_product ps ON ps.product_key=s.product_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT (r_sub='Garden Furniture') r_gf, (s_sub='Garden Furniture') s_gf, (r_sku=s_sku) same_sku, count(*) n, sum(quantity_returned) u
FROM rr WHERE r_sub='Garden Furniture' OR s_sub='Garden Furniture' GROUP BY ALL

-- orphan return lines and product-key validity at return date
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) key_invalid_at_return
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

SELECT count(*) n_lines_returned_total_gt_sold FROM (
 SELECT r.sales_line_id, sum(r.quantity_returned) rq, max(s.quantity) sq FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id)
 WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT r2.sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line r2 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r2.product_key WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r2.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1 OR sum(r.quantity_returned)>max(s.quantity))
